AI Content & Model Licensing Terms

Kriyon Media creates original synthetic models and AI-assisted campaign assets for commercial brand use. Approved deliverables include commercial usage rights as defined in the project agreement. Synthetic models may be shared, personalized or exclusively reserved depending on the selected package.

Commercial Usage

Approved campaign assets for agreed commercial use.

Synthetic Models

Original digital characters built for campaign production.

Character Exclusivity

Available by category, territory and duration.

Reusable Across Campaigns

Bring the same model back for future collections.

01 — Commercial Usage Rights

Approved final deliverables may be used for agreed websites, social media, digital advertising, e-commerce, campaigns, print and brand marketing.

02 — Shared Synthetic Models

Models from Kriyon Media's existing synthetic talent library may be used across multiple client projects. Shared models are non-exclusive.

03 — Personalized Brand Models

Premium packages may include a custom synthetic model developed around the client's brand direction and reusable across future campaigns.

04 — Character Exclusivity

Exclusivity may be purchased separately and defined by category, territory and duration. During the agreed exclusivity period, Kriyon Media will not intentionally use the same character for another competing brand within those agreed limits.

05 — Character Ownership

Unless otherwise agreed in writing, the underlying synthetic character, character system, source assets and production workflows remain Kriyon Media assets. The client receives usage rights to approved final campaign deliverables.

06 — Full Character Buyout

A broader character-rights transfer or full buyout may be offered under a separately priced written agreement.

07 — Client-Supplied Assets

The client confirms that supplied products, logos, trademarks, photographs, designs and reference materials are authorised for the intended commercial use.

08 — Real-Person Likeness

Synthetic characters are intended as original digital identities and are not intended to intentionally replicate celebrities, influencers or real individuals without appropriate permission.

09 — AI-Generated Content

AI-assisted content is subject to evolving intellectual-property laws and third-party platform terms. Commercial usage rights are provided according to the project agreement. Independent copyright registration, absolute uniqueness or worldwide exclusivity are not automatically guaranteed.

10 — Final Agreement

Project-specific usage rights, exclusivity, territory, duration and buyout terms stated in the signed proposal or agreement will control where they differ from these general terms.

These terms form part of Kriyon Media's general production and licensing framework. Specific project agreements may contain additional or overriding terms.
